description: Use this when the couple asks what is next on their own checklist. The signed-in couple's own wedding checklist tasks on Zola: the title, description, notes, due date, and who the task is assigned to, with the counts of the full checklist. By default, the tasks that are past due or due in the next 30 days. Filter by due period, completed tasks, or the tasks assigned to this user. Does not complete a task. Requires Zola sign-in (wedding:read). Do not use for the usual milestones of a wedding date: use zola_get_planning_timeline_template.

assigned_to_me.description: true: only the tasks assigned to this user.

due.description: The due periods to give: past_due, next_30_days, next_60_days, next_90_days, completed, or all. The default is past_due and next_30_days.

limit.description: The most tasks to give, 1 to 100. The default is 25.

name: zola_get_my_checklist

outputSchema.description: The wedding checklist tasks of the signed-in couple

exists.description: False when the couple has no checklist

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

matched.description: The tasks that match, before the limit

assigned_to.description: The first name of the partner

completed_by.description: The first name of the partner

link.description: The zola.com page for the task

totals.description: The counts of the full checklist, with no filter

title: Get My Wedding Checklist
